name: Indonesia

latest_census.notes: Sensus Penduduk 2020 (SP2020) ran as a short form in 2020 and a sample long form in 2022 (delayed by COVID). Ethnicity (suku bangsa) and daily/regional language were asked on the 2022 long form, i.e. on a SAMPLE -- evidenced by UNFPA/BPS 'Profile of Ethnic Groups and Regional Language Diversity: 2020 Population Census Long Form Results' and BPS 'Hasil Long Form Sensus Penduduk 2020'. Religion appears in BPS provincial tables by kabupaten/kota (e.g. DKI Jakarta) but the search snippets do not say whether those figures are SP2020 or Dukcapil registry counts. The last FULL-COUNT publication of all three fields is SP2010: BPS 'Kewarganegaraan, Suku Bangsa, Agama, dan Bahasa Sehari-hari Penduduk Indonesia' (2012), which tabulates 146 ethnic groups, religion and daily language by province. So: religion counted and published by kabupaten (registry and/or census); ethnicity and language counted in full only in 2010 (by province, PDF) and sampled in 2022.

Population Data in Indonesia, such as Demographic Data, Religion, Gender, Marital Status ...'; 'Each province displays complete information including the number of regencies/cities down to ... number of residents'. Related result URLs: web app https://gis.dukcapil.kemendagri.go.id/arcgis/apps/webappviewer/index.html?id=c557104ad5054f488232c2a1235d86ef ; ArcGIS Online item https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=20c44406e97d445ca7f294b6d0ea9c54 ; 29 items tagged kemendagri at https://www.arcgis.com/home/search.html?q=tags:%22kemendagri%22 . A keyless route the repo has not measured (scripts/probe_arcgis.py already exists for Esri items). Registry counts, not a census, but a full count.

subnational_sources.format: CKAN dataset (resources normally CSV/XLSX; CKAN's /api/3/action endpoints are keyless on a standard install -- unverified here)

subnational_sources.evidence: Search result title names the table and level. Sibling datasets on the same portal: 'Jumlah Penduduk Menurut Agama' (by province) https://katalog.satudata.go.id/dataset/jumlah-penduduk-menurut-agama6 and https://data.go.id/dataset/dataset/jumlah-penduduk-menurut-agama6 ; 'Jumlah Penduduk Menurut Agama dan Kecamatan' https://data.go.id/dataset/dataset/jumlah-penduduk-menurut-agama-dan-kecamatan1 ; a village-level one for Kecamatan Sumber. docs/SOURCES.md records data.go.id timing out from the runner; katalog.satudata.go.id is a different host and unmeasured. Coverage across all 34-38 provinces is unknown -- a runner should use the catalogue search.

tier_reason: Religion by kabupaten/kota is a full count (Dukcapil registry and BPS tables) and three keyless hosts carrying it surfaced -- the Dukcapil ArcGIS portal, the Satu Data catalogue (per-province datasets) and the Kemenag open download -- but none is verified as CSV/API at admin2 and two of them are recorded as timing out from the runner. Ethnicity and language: full count only in SP2010, by province, as a PDF (neliti mirror). Not A until a runner confirms one machine-readable kabupaten resource.
recommended_action: 1) Probe the Dukcapil ArcGIS Online item (20c44406e97d445ca7f294b6d0ea9c54) and the 29 kemendagri-tagged items with scripts/probe_arcgis.py: if a public feature layer carries agama attributes per kabupaten/kota, that is a keyless full-count religion source for 518 admin2 shapes (registry, not census -- label it so). 2) Query katalog.satudata.go.id's CKAN API for 'Jumlah Penduduk Menurut Agama dan Kabupaten/Kota di Provinsi' to see how many provinces publish it and in what format. 3) Re-measure satudata.kemenag.go.id's open download endpoint (recorded as a timeout, not a refusal). 4) For ethnicity/language at admin1, read the SP2010 BPS publication PDF from the neliti mirror (33 provinces). 5) The BPS WebAPI key remains the clean census route for religion by kabupaten when the owner registers one. 6) Run the three admin2 Wikipedia sample searches not run here.

summary: Indonesia collects religion for everyone (SP2020 and the Dukcapil civil registry) and publishes it by kabupaten/kota, and three keyless hosts outside the 403/keyed BPS perimeter surfaced: the Kemendagri Dukcapil GIS portal (ArcGIS Online item 20c44406e97d445ca7f294b6d0ea9c54, snippet says it displays religion by province and kabupaten), the national Satu Data catalogue with per-province datasets such as 'Jumlah Penduduk Menurut Agama dan Kabupaten/Kota di Provinsi Sumatera Utara, 2022', and a Kemenag open download endpoint. None is verified as CSV/API at admin2 from a snippet, and SOURCES.md records two of the hosts timing out from the runner, so this is tier B pending one probe -- the ArcGIS feature-layer route is the most promising and the repo already has an Esri prober. Ethnicity and language were fully counted only in SP2010, published by province in the BPS publication 'Kewarganegaraan, Suku Bangsa, Agama, dan Bahasa Sehari-hari' (PDF, mirrored on neliti.com); the 2022 long form re-asked them on a sample and BPS/UNFPA profile ten major groups by province. The three admin2 Wikipedia sample checks were not run because the session's search budget ran out.
